centre.description: A dwarf planet in the Kuiper Belt, with a heart-shaped plain of nitrogen ice, circled by five moons.
knownLimitations: Pluto's picture is the New Horizons colour map; the southern third was in darkness at the flyby and is black.
Pluto is placed from the system's centre of mass plus its own small wobble once its moon fits are loaded, which the view does before its first frame.

mapped.description: Pluto's largest moon, half its size, so the two circle a point between them and always show each other the same face.
